skeleton: The dynamics fit {motif_label}, which in a biological context typically reflects feedback regulation — production balanced against degradation, with the equilibrium set by the ratio of rates. Visible oscillation or overshoot suggests the negative-feedback loop has nontrivial delay; smooth approach to steady state suggests the loop is fast relative to the observation window. Either reading is testable with a perturbation experiment.

Aurora flagged {anomaly_count} biological signals worth review. These are statistical excursions — the ground-truth interpretation needs the experimental context: which condition, which timepoint, what was the perturbation. The system catches the signal; the experimenter assigns its meaning.
